summary: Approximately 622,984 km² and about 5.2 million people (2023), from Wikidata's Q929 (P2046, P1082). The English Wikipedia article "Central African Republic", at revision 1374643087, opens: "The Central African Republic (CAR) is a landlocked country in Central Africa. It is bordered by Chad to the north, Sudan to the northeast, South Sudan to the east, the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the south, the Republic of the Congo to the southwest, and Cameroon to the west. The CAR covers a land area of about 620,000 square kilometres (240,000 sq mi)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Entity 482 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 1 period of territorial validity, from 1960 to where the dataset stops, in 2019. Its last capital in the dataset is Bangui. The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods from 1960-08-13. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
